item.title: Amplify Africa’s Inaugural Afro Ball Honors African Excellence
item.description: Amplify Africa kicked off their inaugural Afro Ball in Los Angeles, CA last month celebrating people of African descent from across the Diaspora who exemplified African Excellence.
